title: Spirituality and Knowledge Dynamics
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
Category: Health, Relationships and Personal development
summary: Spirituality and Knowledge Dynamics is a seminal book bringing together research illuminating how spirituality, wisdom traditions, faith at work, and contemplative practices can positively influence organizational outcomes through knowledge dynamics. It comprises an exquisite collection of eleven intellectually stimulating chapters authored by a distinguished panel of sixteen scholars from fourteen nations.
